description: This file contains source code implementing expression parsing, construction, copying, elimination, comparison, and printing functionalities for configuration expressions within a larger codebase. It defines data structures and functions to manipulate logical and comparison expressions, likely used in configuration or build systems.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_alloc_symbol(struct symbol * sym)
methods.description: Allocates an expression node representing a symbol.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_alloc_one(enum expr_type type,struct expr * ce)
methods.description: Allocates an expression node of a given type with a single child expression.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_alloc_two(enum expr_type type,struct expr * e1,struct expr * e2)
methods.description: Allocates an expression node of a given type with two child expressions.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_alloc_comp(enum expr_type type,struct symbol * s1,struct symbol * s2)
methods.description: Allocates a comparison expression node comparing two symbols.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_copy(const struct expr * org)
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an expression.

methods.name: void expr_free(struct expr * e)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an expression.

methods.name: int expr_eq(struct expr * e1,struct expr * e2)
methods.description: Checks whether two expressions are equal under possible logical simplifications.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_transform(struct expr * e)
methods.description: Performs various simplifications and transformations on an expression.

methods.name: void expr_print(struct expr * e,void (* fn)(void *,struct symbol *,const char *),void * data,int prevtoken)
methods.description: Prints an expression to a callback function.

methods.name: void expr_fprint(struct expr * e,FILE * out)
methods.description: Prints an expression to a FILE stream.

methods.name: void expr_gstr_print_revdep(struct expr * e,struct gstr * gs,tristate pr_type,const char * title)
methods.description: Prints reverse dependency expressions with special formatting.

methods.name: bool expr_depends_symbol(struct expr * dep,struct symbol * sym)
methods.description: Checks if an expression depends on a given symbol.

methods.name: int expr_contains_symbol(struct expr * dep,struct symbol * sym)
methods.description: Checks if an expression contains a given symbol.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_trans_compare(struct expr * e,enum expr_type type,struct symbol * sym)
methods.description: Inserts explicit comparisons of a specified type involving a symbol into an expression.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_eliminate_dups(struct expr * e)
methods.description: Eliminates duplicate or redundant operands from an expression.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_eliminate_yn(struct expr * e)
methods.description: Simplifies expression by eliminating 'yes'/'no' symbol redundancies.

methods.name: void expr_eliminate_eq(struct expr ** ep1,struct expr ** ep2)
methods.description: Eliminates common nodes from two expressions.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_join_or(struct expr * e1,struct expr * e2)
methods.description: Combines two 'OR' expressions if possible.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_join_and(struct expr * e1,struct expr * e2)
methods.description: Combines two 'AND' expressions if possible.
